content: I understand the consequences and want to delete the space

comment.text: Checkbox label in a deletion confirmation dialog for a Form Space, used to confirm the user's intent to proceed with the deletion.

usage.context:
isAIAgent
 ? t("Common:DeleteAIAgentWarning")
 : isTemplate
 ? t("DeleteTemplateWarning")
 : isFormSpace
 ? t("Common:DeleteFormSpaceWarning")
 : t("Common:DeleteRoomWarning")
 }
 dataTestId="delete_warning_checkbox"
 isChecked={isChecked}
 onChange={() => setIsChecked(!isChecked)}
